title: Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton Invites Guests to Immerse Themselves in Madrileño Life
summary: Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton opens as the brand’s first hotel in Europe, introducing a stay inspired by Madrid’s culture.

- **Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton opens as the brand’s first hotel in Europe, introducing an intimate 45-room stay inspired by Madrid’s culture, traditions and everyday life.**
- **The hotel pairs Madrid-born designer Lorenzo Castillo’s interiors with views across the city’s rooftops, and a Madrileño breakfast serving locally roasted coffee.**
- **Set on Calle de Preciados in the heart of the capital, Casa Verbena connects guests with Madrid beyond its best-known sights, including through “Our Madrid,” a seasonal illustrated insider’s guide to local cafés, shops, bars and neighbourhood addresses.**


**MADRID, Spain –** Hilton today announces the opening of[Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/madamid-casa-verbena-madrid/?arrivalDate=2026-11-04&departureDate=2026-11-05&flexibleDates=false&numRooms=1&numAdults=1&numChildren=0&room1ChildAges=&room1AdultAges=&displayCurrency=EUR) , an intimate 45-room hotel on Calle de Preciados in the heart of the capital. With interiors by Madrid-born designer Lorenzo Castillo, views across the city’s rooftops and a traditional Madrileño breakfast each morning, guests are invited to experience a stay inspired by the rhythm of the city’s streets and the hearts of the people who live there.


Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton - Preciados Room


Casa Verbena Madrid takes its name from the traditional Spanish *verbena* : a lively neighbourhood celebration that brings people together through food, music and shared traditions. The hotel also draws on *costumbrismo* , the Spanish artistic tradition of depicting local customs, characters and daily rituals, looking beyond the capital’s landmarks to the cafés, streets and squares that shape life for Madrileños.


-
-


Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton - King Deluxe Room (L) & Twin Superior Room (R)


David Kelly, senior vice president, Continental Europe, Hilton, said, “Madrid is a special destination for Hilton, and in recent years we’ve broadened our presence in the city with distinctive brands and properties designed to meet different traveller needs. Casa Verbena Madrid builds on that story as the European debut of Outset Collection by Hilton. Full of character and with a strong sense of place, the hotel reflects the creativity and energy of Madrid. We’re delighted to welcome the hotel to our growing portfolio of collection properties across Europe.”


## Inside Casa Verbena Madrid


The hotel’s interiors reflect a distinctly local perspective on the city. Costumbrismo-inspired artwork, warm materials, fluted glass, brass finishes and layered textures reference Madrid’s architectural and cultural heritage in a contemporary way.


-
-


Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton - Preciados Room - Top: View
Bottom: Terrace (L) & Terrace Seating (R)


Many guest rooms look onto Preciados street and its typical Madrid façades, while Preciados Rooms open onto terraces with views across the city’s rooftops and towards the Royal Palace.


Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton - Dining Room


Each morning, guests can begin the day in the plush emerald dining room with a Madrileño breakfast featuring churros inspired by the capital’s historic *churrería* culture, *pan con tomate* with Iberian ham, Spanish tortilla, locally roasted coffee and freshly squeezed juice.


## A Local Guide to the Capital


Helping guests discover the city’s local soul, Casa Verbena has worked with a local artist to create a seasonal illustrated insider’s guide to the capital. Available for guests, “Our Madrid” shares recommendations for cafés, shops, bars and neighbourhood addresses loved by locals.


Álvaro Mazaheri, managing director, Arte Hoteles, said, “Casa Verbena Madrid offers a fresh perspective on the capital, whether guests are discovering it for the first time or returning to experience it differently. From a breakfast inspired by local favourites to recommendations we would share with friends, we want each stay to reveal more of the Madrid that lies beyond its best-known sights.”


-
-


Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton - King Corner Room (L) & King Guest Room (R)


“Casa Verbena Madrid represents the essence of Outset Collection, offering guests a stay that feels deeply connected to the destination,” said Elizabeth Scruggs, brand leader, Outset Collection by Hilton. “As our first hotel in Europe, it sets the tone for how we envision the collection growing around the world: through independent hotels with compelling stories, strong local identities and a genuine sense of discovery. With more than 100 hotels under development globally, we are building a collection of individual hotels that invite travellers to experience a destination through a more personal lens, all with the benefits of Hilton.”


As part of Outset Collection, guests at Casa Verbena Madrid can also access Hilton Honors, Hilton’s award-winning guest loyalty programme. Members will be able to book, earn and redeem Hilton Honors Points for stays through Hilton’s direct channels and enjoy the Hilton Honors benefits they know and love.


For more information or to book a reservation, visit[hilton.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/) . Read more about **Outset Collection by Hilton** here[stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/launch-of-outset-collection-by-hilton) .


##### FAQ: Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton Invites Guests to Immerse Themselves in Madrileño Life


Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton is an intimate 45-room hotel on Calle de Preciados in central Madrid. It is the first Outset Collection by Hilton hotel in Europe.


The hotel is located on Calle de Preciados in the heart of Madrid, placing guests in the centre of the Spanish capital.


Casa Verbena takes its name from the traditional Spanish *verbena* , a neighbourhood celebration centred around food, music and shared traditions. The hotel also draws on *costumbrismo* , the Spanish artistic tradition of depicting local customs and daily rituals, with a stay designed to reflect Madrid beyond its best-known landmarks.


The interiors are designed by Madrid-born designer Lorenzo Castillo and feature costumbrismo-inspired artwork, warm materials, fluted glass, brass finishes and layered textures referencing Madrid’s architectural and cultural heritage. Many guest rooms look onto Preciados street and its typical Madrid façades, while Preciados Rooms feature terraces with views across the city’s rooftops and towards the Royal Palace.


Guests can start the day with a Madrileño breakfast featuring churros, *pan con tomate* with Iberian ham, Spanish tortilla, locally roasted coffee and freshly squeezed juice. The hotel also offers “Our Madrid,” a seasonal illustrated insider’s guide recommending cafés, shops, bars and neighbourhood addresses loved by locals.
